answer.rationale: Roll out the already validated shorter onboarding flow for self-serve SMB accounts. It improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, making it the strongest available lever for durable SMB value under price pressure. Do not answer the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment increased acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating a clear sustainable-revenue risk. This does not establish that onboarding alone will offset competitor-driven churn, but it improves demonstrated value realization without repeating the known discounting failure mode.
